# `kernel/navi/ModelRouteExperienceProfile.js`

> **Source:** `webgpu-os/kernel/navi/ModelRouteExperienceProfile.js`

Shadow-only task-effectiveness evidence for Navi model routes. NaviModelBroker already owns short-lived endpoint/transport reliability. This module deliberately does not replace, feed, or import into that live score. It joins a content-free broker execution receipt to an independently content-addressed Storylet outcome, then derives an offline association profile for the exact task, Storylet stage, model, provider, and route configuration. Prompts, model output, tool arguments/results, paths, and target identities are never retained. Current deterministic routing has no counterfactual support, so every v1 observation records a 100% logging propensity and an explicit `insufficient-support` off-policy status. No projection grants authority or can affect the live route frontier/order.

### `async evaluateStoryletModelExperienceHeldOutShadow({ trainingProfiles: trainingValues = [], heldOutProfiles: heldOutValues = [], baselinePolicyHash, candidatePolicyHash, rollbackPolicyHash, minimumPositiveObservations = STORYLET_MODEL_EXPERIENCE_LIMITS.defaultMinimumDirectObservations, asOf = Date.now()`

## Notes & Examples

### Command Bus Pattern

The OS uses a capability-gated command bus for inter-app and system communication. Apps register command handlers; the kernel routes commands based on capabilities. Commands can be local (same app), cross-app (with permission), or system-level (elevated).

**Example: Command registration and invocation**
```js
import { CommandBus } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/CommandBus.js';
import { Capability } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/Capability.js';

const bus = new CommandBus();

// Register a handler (requires 'ui' capability)
bus.register('myapp:openFile', async (path) => {
  const content = await storage.read(path);
  return { content, size: content.length };
}, { capability: 'storage' });

// Invoke locally
const result = await bus.invoke('myapp:openFile', '/docs/readme.md');

// Cross-app invocation (requires 'interop' capability)
const otherApp = bus.proxy('otherapp');
const data = await otherApp.invoke('otherapp:compute', input);

// Broadcast to all listening apps
bus.broadcast('system:themeChanged', { theme: 'dark' });
```

**See also:** [WebGPU OS Architecture](/webgpu-os/architecture.md) · [Security Model](/concepts/security-model.md)
